# system.toast

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--new">since 26.2.0</span></div>

Display a short message at the bottom of the screen, closed after a delay or when touched. A new toast replaces the previous one.

```lua
system.toast(text[, color[, duration]])
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | yes |  |
| `color` | number | optional | background color, the theme "safe" color (green) by default. The text color (black or white) is chosen for contrast |
| `duration` | number | optional | in ms, 2000 by default, 10000 max |

## Returns

Nothing.

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
system.toast("Saved")
system.toast("Battery low", lcd.RGB(255, 0, 0), 5000)
system.toast("No GPS fix", lcd.themeColor(THEME_ERROR_COLOR))
```
